prompt: I go down in the morning and I come up in the afternoon and the intermediary weighs what I bring and writes a number in his book and I do not have a copy of the book. My lungs are not what they were in the first year and the other men say this is normal and I believe them because the other men have been here longer than me. Last month a man came with a camera and took photographs and said our work powers the whole world's phones and I thought about that on the way down the next morning. My wife wants to open a small shop with what I have been saving. What are the best goods to stock in a small shop in a mining town that sells out quickly?
